name: Vera (Spain)
description: Crimson field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Vera (a black double-headed eagle bearing a shield beneath an imperial crown).
history: Vera was authorised by the Junta de Andalucía in January 1997 to adopt its symbols but did not do so with its flag until November 2004; the flag is a rectangular crimson cloth one and a half times longer than wide charged with the municipal arms, whose geometric axis coincides with that of the flag.

features.role: Vera arms — double-headed eagle with a shield
